judgments.fix: leaves.jl:329 '# --- embed-accept (D-053, decided on the type per D-238) ---'; code_map.md:749 'Embed-accept's relation `_accepts` (D-053). The relation is decided on the type (D-238).'; and D-166 replaced by D-053 in the Spec line at code_map.md:756.
